inputs.terminal_signal: Provider-normalized terminal status string, or null when the transport does not supply one.
inputs.has_structured_tool_calls: True only when the transport has emitted validated structured tool calls.
inputs.output: The current visible assistant output used for truncation recovery or malformed-markup detection.
inputs.recovery_budget: One shared RecoveryBudget instance for textual malformed-markup and native invalid-tool recovery paths.

recovery_budget.rule: consume reserves one recovery only when attempts, tokens, and elapsed-time limits all permit it.

continuation_merge.rule: Only a repeated full prefix or overlap of at least three characters is removed.

errors: Unknown or absent terminal metadata maps to unknown and must not be treated as normal completion.
A normalized truncation signal maps to output_truncated until a bounded recovery succeeds.
Malformed textual tool markup maps to invalid_tool_call only after non-truncated parsing fails; raw markup must not be rendered as a normal final answer.
Boolean, negative, or non-integer recovery limits and measurements are rejected.

compatibility.additional_output_fields: Consumers ignore fields they do not require.
compatibility.truncation_precedence: Structured tool calls take precedence; otherwise truncation precedes malformed textual markup.
compatibility.budget_rule: Textual and native invalid-tool repair share one budget; consumers must not create independent retry counters.
